title: Scrutiny of returns
content: The proper officer may scrutinize the return and related particulars furnished by the registered person to verify the correctness of the return and inform him of the discrepancies noticed, if any, in such manner as may be prescribed and seek his explanation thereto. In case the explanation is found acceptable, the registered person shall be informed accordingly. Where no satisfactory explanation is furnished within a period of thirty days or such further period as may be permitted, the proper officer may initiate appropriate action.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Determination of tax not paid or short paid for any reason other than fraud or wilful misstatement
content: Where it appears to the proper officer that any tax has not been paid or short paid or erroneously refunded, or where input tax credit has been wrongly availed or utilized for any reason other than the reason of fraud or any wilful misstatement or suppression of facts to evade tax, he shall serve notice on the person chargeable with tax requiring him to show cause why he should not pay the amount specified in the notice along with interest under section 50 and a penalty leviable under the Act.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Determination of tax not paid or short paid by reason of fraud or any wilful misstatement or suppression of facts
content: Where it appears to the proper officer that any tax has not been paid or short paid or erroneously refunded or input tax credit wrongly availed or utilized by reason of fraud, or any wilful misstatement or suppression of facts to evade tax, he shall serve notice on the person chargeable with tax requiring him to show cause why he should not pay the amount along with interest under section 50 and penalty equivalent to the tax specified.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Interest on delayed payment of tax
content: Every person who is liable to pay tax in accordance with the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder, but fails to pay the tax to the Government within the period prescribed, shall for the period for which the tax or any part thereof remains unpaid, pay, on his own, interest at such rate, not exceeding eighteen per cent. Provided that interest on tax payable in respect of supplies made during a tax period declared in return shall be payable on that portion of the tax which is paid by debiting the electronic cash ledger.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Levy of late fee
content: Any registered person who fails to furnish the details of outward or inward supplies or return required under section 39 by the due date shall pay a late fee of one hundred rupees for every day during which such failure continues subject to a maximum amount of five thousand rupees (as rationalized by notifications).
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Notice to return defaulters
content: Where a registered person fails to furnish a return under section 39 or section 44 or section 45, a notice shall be issued requiring him to furnish such return within fifteen days in such form and manner as may be prescribed.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Cancellation or suspension of registration
content: The proper officer may, either on his own motion or on an application filed by the registered person, cancel the registration of a person from such date, including any retrospective date, as he may deem fit, where the registered person has contravened prescribed provisions or failed to furnish returns.
authority: CBIC / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India

title: Scrutiny of returns
content: Where any return furnished by a registered person is selected for scrutiny, the proper officer shall scrutinize the same in accordance with the provisions of section 61 and issue a notice to the said person in FORM GST ASMT-10. The registered person may accept the discrepancy and pay the tax or furnish an explanation in FORM GST ASMT-11 within a period of thirty days.
authority: CBIC / Department of Revenue, Govt of India
